body.name: aptu.dev
body.description: Machine-payable API infrastructure for autonomous agents. Pay per call in USDC on Base or Solana.

services.description: Echoes a JSON {message} back; the simplest paid call for verifying your x402 payment flow.
Scores a resume 0-4 against an ATS rubric (impact, parseability, executive framing, contact).

Audits a domain's agent readiness against the aptu-readiness-1 rubric (origin headers, robots.txt, llms.txt, sitemap, agents.txt, skill.md, JSON-LD, mcp.json, A2A card, x402 manifest), weighted 0-100; rubric: https://aptu.dev/agent-readiness-checks
BTC spot regime check against a 7-day moving average gate (bull/bear, MA7, deviation pct, favor-entry/block-entry action).

Seller-side x402 protocol conformance pre-flight check for a deployed resource URL (schema validation, mechanism reachability, facilitator cross-check, advisory scar-tissue findings) with a graded 0-100 report and per-failure remedies.

Re-probes a domain and returns nine ready-to-host machine-surface artifacts (llms.txt, robots.txt, sitemap.xml, agents.txt, skill.md, mcp.json, agent-card.json) templated from probe facts; rubric at https://aptu.dev/readiness-fix-checks.
